candidate_grammar.boundary: Prime sectors five and seven; down/up cover powers three/four; the complete exact cubic grid; all three root intervals; complete neutral sector fibres; all three lepton transitions; exact positive whole/fraction carriers; and no physical target before seal.

candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete product of sector, kind, depth, invariant, root-census, mass-ratio, neutral-singlet, stability, abundance, flavour-weight, measurement-boundary and extension forms.

excluded_inputs: no V1/V2 code, answer table, survivor identifier or measurement in formal execution
no fitted mass, coupling, cross-section, freeze-out efficiency, density, branching fraction or search limit
no negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, NaN, infinite or continuum proof scalar
no claim that an unobserved Smithion mass has already been experimentally measured
no claim that non-detection alone identifies the relic
intended_certificate: Complete 2048-form census; four exact cubics, twelve rational root enclosures, neutral-lightest relic, 27/5 abundance, complete LFV table and independent reconstruction.
statement: Four exact penta/hepta cubics at depths (7,10,9,12) each have three disjoint positive roots, yielding twelve exact rationally enclosed Smithion mass-ratio predictions. Their coloured product family cross-locks the two quark values 3/1454 and 3/13118. Complete neutral p-member singlets and unique lightest roots force the stable relic class within the closed grammar. Dark/baryon is 27/5 and matter/baryon 32/5. Flavour weights are exactly 1/32, 5/96 and 5/24, reducing to 3:5:20 with tau-to-e over tau-to-mu equal to 4. Sector beta slopes are p-1.
title: Terminal dark relic, Smithion spectrum and flavour-transition law
